issues.title: Remove concept of a data-type being "complete"
issues.body:
We used to track which game-admin tabs were complete.

We have removed this from the UI.  We can also now remove the `complete` flag from the data-types:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/165299117-850477c3-c91f-4f52-bfff-60ebeaffdd5f.png)
